title: CLI Core Components
summary: This module provides the foundational components for the CrewAI Command Line Interface, handling user authentication, secure communication with the CrewAI+ API, and basic command initialization.

nodes.label: Handle User Authentication
nodes.title: Authentication Command
nodes.description: Manages user login processes, including authentication with the CrewAI+ platform and the tool repository, providing feedback on success or failure.

nodes.label: Interact with CrewAI+ API
nodes.title: Plus API Interaction Mixin
nodes.description: Provides methods for secure communication with the CrewAI+ API, handling authentication, request validation, and error reporting for API responses.

nodes.label: Initialize CLI Command
nodes.title: Base CLI Command
nodes.description: Serves as the foundational class for all CLI commands, primarily responsible for initializing telemetry for usage tracking.

nodes.label: Telemetry Service
nodes.title: Telemetry Service
nodes.description: An external service responsible for collecting and reporting usage data and tracing information from the CLI commands.

nodes.label: CrewAI+ API Client
nodes.title: CrewAI+ API Client
nodes.description: An external client library used to make authenticated requests to the CrewAI+ backend API for various operations.

nodes.label: Tool Repository Commands
nodes.title: Tool Repository Commands
nodes.description: Represents the module responsible for managing operations related to the CrewAI Tool Repository, such as tool login, download, and publishing.

nodes.label: CLI Settings Configuration
nodes.title: CLI Settings
nodes.description: Provides access to application-wide configuration settings, including organization name and UUID, used for displaying user context.

groups.label: Core CLI Functions
groups.title: Core CLI Functionality
groups.description: Encapsulates the fundamental building blocks and common utilities for CrewAI CLI commands, including authentication and API interaction.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: External System Integrations
groups.description: Represents external services and modules that the core CLI components interact with, such as telemetry, API clients, and configuration.
